findings.message: Camunda 7 correlates message "Paid" by API call (business key, process variables or instance id); the model names no key, and Camunda 8 requires one.
findings.suggestion: Add <zeebe:subscription correlationKey="=…"/> to message "m", naming the variable publishers correlate on.

findings.message: Execution platform set to Camunda Cloud 8.10.0 (was Camunda Platform).
findings.suggestion: Camunda Modeler opens the file as a Camunda 8 diagram.

xml:
